messages:
Asha: quick heads-up — after the kernel switch last deploy I'm seeing an uptick in small-batch formation for long-context (>=8k) requests. latency p50 is fine but p95 spikes and we see more soft-429s on the ingest lane :confused:

Matt: ugh. can you paste a quick perf snippet? which kernel?

Asha: switched to wave-kernel-v2 on t4p trial. sampling from last 3h:
```
- total requests: 12.6k
- kv hit rate: 21% on 8k requests (used to be ~42%)
- avg batch size (8k): 3.1 -> changed from 6.8
- p95 latency (tokens): 1.9s -> 3.6s
- soft-429 rate (ingest): 0.5% -> 2.4%
```

Leo: that kv hit drop is suspicious. kernel v2 changed prefetch ordering, right? might be causing KV cache eviction pattern differences so we don't reuse prefixes across windows.

Sam: if kv hits drop we get smaller assembled batches (more key misses = shorter continuations), which then triggers the token-budget admit earlier. we should check admission logs for token-budget breaching events.

Asha: attached a sample trace (stacked): request id 7e3f.. shows 3 microbatches, each created with max_wait=6ms. the batcher cut earlier than before.

Matt: two quick mitigation ideas:
1) temporarily relax token_budget_target down from 0.65 -> 0.55 for ingest lane to reduce soft-429s. that buys us headroom.
2) add a small kernel-hint: prefer legacy-prefetch kernel for sequences >6k until we verify kv-change impact.

Leo: agree on conservative fallback. also want to record a metric for "batch_hold_time_ms" distribution per kernel to validate. can we add a histogram in the batcher?

Sam: +1. Also propose an experiment: run A/B where 10% of traffic uses v2 but with increased prefetch window (prefetch=3 -> 6) to see if kv hit recovers. collect kv_hit_rate, batch_size, p95, soft429.

Asha: updated the rollout doc in the PR: https://stash/repo/infra/wave-kernel-v2-rollout. I added a dashboard prototype and the metric names: batcher.batch_size_avg, batcher.batch_hold_ms_p{50,95}, admission.soft_429_count, kv.prefix_hit_rate.

Matt: for immediate ops: I'll push a short rollback toggle and set token_budget_target change as an experiment flag (ingest only). Sam, can you own the A/B traffic split + dashboard panels?

Sam: yeah I'll wire up the panels and add alerts: (1) soft_429 rate >1% sustained 5m, (2) kv.prefix_hit_rate drop >10% vs baseline.

Leo: perf-bot — can you run the nightly microbench with wave-kernel-v2 + prefetch=6 and post results to this thread?

perf-bot: scheduled nightly run: wave-kernel-v2 (prefetch=6). expected completion 2026-03-18T06:30Z. will post histogram and diff in morning. :robot_face:

Asha: thanks. action items summarized:
- Matt: deploy toggle + temporary token_budget_target change for ingest (rollbackable)
- Sam: A/B split + dashboards + alerts
- Leo: add batcher.batch_hold_ms histogram + perf instrumentation PR
- Asha: collect traces for 50 failing requests and attach to the issue
- perf-bot: run nightly bench and post results

Matt: will do the toggle in the next 15m and notify on #eng-oncall if anything odd. :thumbsup:
